svg.title: B15 TECTON ORION — Farallon Slab Reconstruction engineering architecture
svg.desc: The model diagram couples mechanical and thermal physics while gating inference on numerical verification and independent geological groups. It exposes ancient-boundary and dimensionality uncertainty rather than claiming one recovered tectonic history.
